run_racecar_simulation: run the pybullet racecar simulation with GUI sliders for velocity, force, and steering control
load_racecar_urdf: load the racecar URDF model into a pybullet simulation and inspect its joint information
control_racecar_joints: control racecar wheel joints using VELOCITY_CONTROL and steering joints using POSITION_CONTROL
create_debug_sliders: create user debug parameter sliders to interactively adjust wheel velocity, max force, and steering angle
load_stadium_scene: load the stadium SDF scene into pybullet as the environment for the racecar simulation
